title: pteris occidentalis
intro: Pteris occidentalis, commonly known as the western bracken fern, is a species of fern native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pteris occidentalis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticoagulant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
